title: add RAG templates and agent/tooling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Asha Patel
description:
Context: Add opinionated RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts to help developers onboard faster and reduce recurring questions in support. This PR adds reusable RAG templates, a new quickstart for building an agent that uses tool-calling with Redwood, and small docs site navigation updates to surface the new content.

Motivation: We've seen repeated requests on community and support for canonical RAG starter prompts and a concise agent quickstart that demonstrates tool calling and structured outputs. This work complements the existing examples in redwood-examples and provides docs-first reference material for the docs site and SDK users.

What I changed: added rag templates under docs/rag/templates, a new quickstart at docs/quickstarts/agents-tool-calling.md, two example agent scripts under examples/agents/tool-calling (Python + Typescript), updated site navigation to include a RAG/Agents section, and added a small diagram asset.

Checklist:
- [x] Add RAG templates and sample prompts
- [x] Add agent tool-calling quickstart (Python + TS)
- [x] Update docs site nav and sidebar
- [x] Include minimal tests (link checks + example smoke run)
- [x] Add release notes entry

Testing: Local mkdocs build, linkcheck, and smoke-run of the Python quickstart against a local Redwood dev server. CI ran docs build and linkcheck; initial linkcheck failed on a renamed anchor which I fixed in a follow-up commit.

Follow-ups: Add additional language examples in redwood-examples; add an eval harness to validate template outputs across model variants (tracked in ENG-2719).

Related linear tickets: ENG-2608, ENG-2719

Notes: Kept the templates intentionally opinionated (explicit retrieval prompts, chunking guidance, and fallback behaviour) to reduce copy-paste mistakes. The quickstart includes a small tool interface example (search API + execution tracer).
